name: Arjonilla (Spain)
description: White field with two black triangles with their bases along the hoist and the fly and their apexes at the centre, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arjonilla (a castle on green).
history: Municipal flag of Arjonilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
